_help: Podaci za sletanje po tipu aviona za aplikaciju Landing. Svaki tip: name, applies (ICAO tipovi), source, info (lista), limits (tailwind, crosswindDry, crosswindWet u kt), autobrake: [uslov, kočnice, reverse, flaps, ključ (dryLong | dryShort | wet | cat2dry | cat2wet | cont | narrow)], notes, vapp (true ako važi korekcija ½ čeonog + udar, min 5 maks 20). Samo pravi podaci kompanije – ništa ne izmišljati.

EJET.name: Embraer E190 / E195
EJET.source: Air Serbia Virtual – Landing Data & Performance Tables (Embraer), revision 1.0
info: Consider landing distance based on max manual braking
Use manual braking and the HUD deceleration scale after touchdown (if applicable)
notes: Autobrake must be set to HI when MED is not sufficient according to the performance software analysis.
If runway occupancy is a concern and a rapid exit near the apron is available, refer to the airport briefing.
Check deceleration on the HGS deceleration scale; at any slippage take over at once with maximum manual braking.
If directional control is a concern, consider using less than maximum reverse.
